title: Who Transfers Safety? Identifying and Targeting Cross-Lingual Shared Safety Neurons

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the disparity in model safety guardrails across different languages by measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of jailbreak prompts on multilingual datasets (AdvBench-x and MultiJail), comparing high-resource languages (e.g., English) against non-high-resource languages (e.g., Chinese, Korean, Bengali, Afrikaans).
